```{r}
#loading data
df <- read.csv("C:\\Users\\railt\\DataScienceFanClub\\Data\\preprocessed_data.csv")
#removing feature X16 because of 1 to 1 correlation
df <- df[, !names(df) %in% c('X16', 'X16_1yr', 'X16_2yr', 'X16_3yr')]
df_log <- df
```


```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyr)
library(caret)
library(dplyr)
```

```{r}

#do a signed log transform on all features to reduce skewness
df_log[,7:74] <-(sign(df[,7:74]) * log(1 + abs(df[,7:74])))


```

```{r}
set.seed(666)
#generate unique company name
companies <- df %>% distinct(company_name) 
companies <- pull(companies)

#divide company in test and train company crossectionally
train_companies <- sample(companies, size =floor(0.7*length(companies)))
test_companies <- setdiff(companies, train_companies)
df_train_companies <- df %>% filter(company_name %in% train_companies)
df_test_companies  <- df %>% filter(company_name %in% test_companies)
df_train_companies_log <- df_log %>% filter(company_name %in% train_companies)
df_test_companies_log  <- df_log %>% filter(company_name %in% test_companies)
#splt the train data into <2015 and test >=2015
cutoff <- 2014

df_train <- df_train_companies %>% filter(year < cutoff)
df_test <- df_test_companies %>% filter(year >= cutoff)

df_train_log <- df_train_companies_log %>% filter(year < cutoff)
df_test_log <- df_test_companies_log %>% filter(year >= cutoff)

```

```{r}


#remove(categorical, sample index, and company name)
feature_to_scale = colnames(df)[-c(1,2,4,5,6)]

#record set of means and stds for each feature in the train data
scaler <- preProcess(df_train_log[, feature_to_scale], method = c('center','scale'))

#scale both train and test data using the means and stds value from the train data
train_scaled <- predict(scaler, df_train_log)
test_scaled <- predict(scaler, df_test_log)

```

```{r}

write.csv(df_train_log, "C:\\Users\\railt\\DataScienceFanClub\\Data\\df_train_log.csv")
write.csv(df_test_log, "C:\\Users\\railt\\DataScienceFanClub\\Data\\df_test_log.csv")

write.csv(df_train, "C:\\Users\\railt\\DataScienceFanClub\\Data\\df_train.csv")
write.csv(df_test, "C:\\Users\\railt\\DataScienceFanClub\\Data\\df_test.csv")

write.csv(train_scaled, "C:\\Users\\railt\\DataScienceFanClub\\Data\\df_train_log_scaled.csv")
write.csv(test_scaled, "C:\\Users\\railt\\DataScienceFanClub\\Data\\df_test_log_scaled.csv")

```
